articles.title: Critical WordPress Vulnerability Exploited Immediately After Disclosure
articles.executive_summary: A critical WordPress vulnerability (CVE-2026-87902) has been exploited by remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. This flaw poses a significant operational risk to organizations relying on WordPress.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability is a path traversal flaw that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code. The flaw was disclosed and immediately exploited, indicating a lack of preparedness among WordPress users.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest WordPress patches and updates
Implement network containment and firewall rules to block unauthorized access
Monitor logs and detection systems for suspicious activity related to CVE-2026-87902
articles.telegram_snippet: Critical WordPress vulnerability (CVE-2026-87902) exploited immediately after disclosure, allowing remote code execution. Apply latest patches and updates to mitigate risk.

articles.title: EDR Evasion Stack Helps Process Injection Slip Past Defenses
articles.executive_summary: A new evasion technique allows attackers to inject code into process initialization structures, evading endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools. This technique poses a significant risk to enterprise networks, as it can be used to deliver malware or execute malicious code.
articles.technical_breakdown: The evasion technique uses process parameter-poisoning to inject code into process initialization structures, bypassing traditional EDR detection methods. This is achieved without utilizing the Windows APIs that EDR tools typically monitor.
actionable_mitigations: Implement process initialization structure validation and monitoring
Enforce strict access controls and least privilege principles
Enhance EDR tool configurations to detect and prevent process parameter-poisoning attacks
articles.telegram_snippet: New evasion technique allows attackers to inject code into process initialization structures, evading EDR tools and posing a significant risk to enterprise networks.

articles.title: Hackers start exploiting critical WordPress flaw for code execution
articles.executive_summary: Threat actors are exploiting a critical WordPress vulnerability to execute code on vulnerable sites, posing a significant risk to data integrity and system security. This flaw allows attackers to write files to disk that execute shell commands when accessed, enabling further malicious activity.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability, CVE-2026-87902, allows attackers to write files to disk that execute shell commands when accessed, enabling code execution and further malicious activity. This flaw is being exploited by threat actors, who are moving from probing vulnerable sites to actively exploiting the flaw.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest WordPress patches and updates to address CVE-2026-87902
Implement network containment and firewall rules to block suspicious traffic
Monitor system logs and detect indicators of compromise, such as unusual file writes or shell command execution
articles.telegram_snippet: Threat actors are exploiting a critical WordPress vulnerability (CVE-2026-87902) to execute code on vulnerable sites, posing a significant risk to data integrity and system security. Apply latest patches and updates to mitigate the risk.

articles.title: One URL, Three Different Tricks
articles.executive_summary: A phishing email with a carefully crafted link was sent, attempting to bypass basic security controls. The link uses multiple techniques to evade detection, posing a significant risk to enterprise networks.
articles.technical_breakdown: The link uses a combination of URL encoding, parameter manipulation, and domain name spoofing to evade detection by security controls. This allows the attacker to deliver malicious content to unsuspecting users.
actionable_mitigations: Implement URL filtering and parameter validation to detect and block suspicious links
Enforce strict domain name validation to prevent spoofing
Monitor for suspicious network activity and user behavior
articles.telegram_snippet: Phishing email with carefully crafted link attempts to bypass security controls, posing a significant risk to enterprise networks. Implement URL filtering and parameter validation to detect and block suspicious links.

articles.title: Placeholder domain used in dev docs now serves ClickFix attacks
articles.executive_summary: A commonly used placeholder domain in developer documentation is now serving fake Cloudflare verification pages that attempt to trick Windows users into executing PowerShell commands. This attack vector poses a significant risk to organizations that rely on developer documentation and code examples.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attack exploits the use of the placeholder domain in developer documentation, which is often used as a default value in code examples. The fake Cloudflare verification page is designed to trick Windows users into executing PowerShell commands, which can lead to malware execution or other malicious activities.
actionable_mitigations: Review and update code examples to use more secure placeholder domains
Implement strict PowerShell execution policies
Monitor for suspicious PowerShell activity
articles.telegram_snippet: A commonly used placeholder domain in dev docs now serves fake Cloudflare pages, attempting to trick Windows users into executing PowerShell commands. Organizations should review code examples and implement strict PowerShell policies to mitigate this risk.

articles.title: New RemControl Android banking malware targets users in Europe and Canada
articles.threat_category: Ransomware | Data Breach | 0-Day & Exploit | Nation-State/APT | Cloud & Supply Chain | Vulnerability / Advisory
articles.executive_summary: A new Android malware-as-a-service platform called RemControl is targeting users in Europe and Canada through malvertising campaigns impersonating the TVTap IPTV application. The malware is designed to steal banking information and other sensitive data.
articles.technical_breakdown: RemControl malware is distributed through malvertising campaigns that impersonate the TVTap IPTV application, exploiting users' trust to download and install the malware. The malware then steals banking information and other sensitive data from infected devices.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure all Android apps are downloaded from trusted sources, such as the Google Play Store
Use a reputable mobile antivirus solution to scan for malware
Avoid clicking on suspicious links or ads, especially those that ask for sensitive information
articles.telegram_snippet: New Android malware called RemControl targets users in Europe and Canada through malvertising campaigns, stealing banking info and sensitive data.

articles.title: GitLab Email Addresses Can Be Weaponized for Supply Chain Attacks
articles.executive_summary: Attackers can use automatically assigned access tokens in GitLab email addresses to launch supply chain attacks. This vulnerability allows for highly privileged access to the platform.
articles.technical_breakdown: Incoming email addresses on GitLab contain highly privileged access tokens that attackers can exploit. These tokens grant attackers elevated access to the platform, enabling supply chain attacks.
actionable_mitigations: Verify and validate access tokens for all incoming email addresses
Implement strict access controls and role-based access management
Monitor and log all access attempts to detect potential threats
articles.telegram_snippet: GitLab email addresses contain access tokens that attackers can use for supply chain attacks. Verify and validate access tokens to prevent potential threats.

articles.title: Attackers Use Malicious Terraform Providers to Deliver Go Malware via HashiCorp Registry
articles.executive_summary: Threat actors are using HashiCorp's Terraform registry to distribute Go-based malware, exploiting the centralized repository to deliver malicious payloads. This marks a new distribution vector for malicious payloads, highlighting the importance of secure software supply chain management.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attackers are utilizing two Go Modules and two Terraform providers to deliver the Go-based malware, taking advantage of the HashiCorp registry's centralized nature to spread the malicious payloads. The malware is designed to evade detection and cause harm to affected systems.
actionable_mitigations: Verify the authenticity of Terraform providers and Go modules before use
Use secure software supply chain management practices
Monitor for suspicious activity in the HashiCorp registry
articles.telegram_snippet: Threat actors are using HashiCorp's Terraform registry to distribute Go-based malware, marking a new distribution vector for malicious payloads. Affected systems should be monitored for suspicious activity and secure software supply chain management practices should be implemented.

articles.executive_summary: Check Point warns of hackers exploiting Security Gateway VPN RCE flaw. Cybersecurity company Check Point has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the VPN certificate-handling functionality of its Security Gateway product.
articles.technical_breakdown: Analysis of incident reported by BleepingComputer. The threat involves attack vectors targeting standard services. Further technical telemetry is developing.
actionable_mitigations: Review firewall and perimeter access logs for anomalous traffic patterns.
Verify all endpoint detection (EDR) agents are updated with latest behavioral signatures.
Audit exposed external assets and apply vendor security patches immediately.
